title: REA Line-Breaking Knuth-Plass/Greedy Hybrid & Pagination Solver

vectors.name: Character Advance & Metric Measurement
vectors.description: Validates character advance width, ascent, and descent calculations across 10pt, 12pt, and 24pt fonts.
vectors.input: Characters 'a' and space at sizes 20, 24, and 48 half-points in Calibri.

vectors.name: Kerning Pair Adjustments
vectors.description: Validates kerning adjustment negative advance for ('A', 'V') and zero adjustment for ('A', 'B').

vectors.name: Whitespace Compression at Line End
vectors.description: Validates that trailing spaces at the end of a line do not cause premature line overflow or extra lines.
vectors.input: Text 'Hello world     ' in content box sized for 'Hello world'.

vectors.name: Non-Breaking Space Handling
vectors.description: Validates that U+00A0 non-breaking space prevents line breaking between adjacent tokens.

vectors.name: Soft Hyphen Handling
vectors.description: Validates soft hyphen U+00AD zero width inside lines and visible hyphen glyph '-' when broken at.
vectors.input: Text with soft hyphen 'super\u{00AD}califragilistic' in constrained box.

vectors.name: Tab Stop Advancement
vectors.description: Validates horizontal tab stop character advancement to default half-inch (720 twips) interval.

vectors.name: Kinsoku Prohibited Line-Start Characters
vectors.description: Validates classification of CJK and Latin punctuation prohibited at line starts (closing brackets, commas, periods).

vectors.name: Kinsoku Prohibited Line-End Characters
vectors.description: Validates classification of opening punctuation and currency symbols prohibited at line ends.

vectors.name: Greedy Line Breaker
vectors.description: Validates greedy line breaking algorithm wrapping lines when token advances exceed content box width.

vectors.name: Knuth-Plass Justified Line Breaking
vectors.description: Validates Knuth-Plass total-fit dynamic programming line-breaker for justified text.
vectors.input: Justified paragraph with 15 words in 3000-twip column.

vectors.name: Knuth-Plass Demerits & Penalties
vectors.description: Validates dynamic programming optimal breakpoint selection minimizing line stretch/shrink demerits.

vectors.name: Paragraph Horizontal Alignments (Left, Right, Center)
vectors.description: Validates X-coordinate shifts for left, right, and center paragraph alignments.
vectors.input: Three paragraphs with left, right, and center alignments.

vectors.name: Paragraph First Line Indentation
vectors.description: Validates first line indent (w:firstLine) reducing first line available width by specified twips.

vectors.name: Paragraph Hanging Indentation
vectors.description: Validates hanging indent (w:hanging) shifting subsequent lines relative to paragraph margin.

vectors.name: Line Height Auto Spacing
vectors.description: Validates auto line height calculation for single line spacing (line=240, 1.15x multiplier).

vectors.name: Line Height Exact Spacing
vectors.description: Validates exact line height calculation (lineRule='exact', line=400 twips).

vectors.name: Line Height AtLeast Spacing
vectors.description: Validates atLeast line height calculation choosing maximum of natural height and line setting.

vectors.name: Paragraph Spacing Before & After
vectors.description: Validates vertical gap between consecutive paragraphs combining space_after and space_before.

vectors.name: Single Page Layout Dimensions
vectors.description: Validates US Letter page bounds, margins, and content box coordinates.
vectors.input: Single paragraph document with US Letter 1-inch margins.

vectors.name: Multi-Page Pagination
vectors.description: Validates multi-page document pagination when content height exceeds printable page height.

vectors.name: Page Break Before Constraint
vectors.description: Validates w:pageBreakBefore forcing immediate page break before designated paragraph.
vectors.input: Two paragraphs with second having pageBreakBefore=true.

vectors.name: Keep Lines Together Constraint
vectors.description: Validates w:keepLines moving entire paragraph to next page when it cannot fit without splitting.

vectors.name: Keep With Next Constraint
vectors.description: Validates w:keepNext pushing heading to next page to prevent leaving orphaned heading at bottom.
vectors.input: Near-bottom heading with keepNext=true followed by content.

vectors.name: Widow & Orphan Control
vectors.description: Validates ECMA-376 w:widowControl preventing 1-line orphans at bottom and 1-line widows at top.
vectors.input: 3-line paragraph near page bottom with space for only 1 line.

vectors.name: Multi-Column Section Flow
vectors.description: Validates text flow through column 0, column 1, and subsequent columns in multi-column sections.

vectors.name: CJK Ideograph Line Breaking
vectors.description: Validates Japanese / CJK full-width ideograph tokenization and line breaking with Kinsoku Shori.
vectors.input: Japanese sentence with quotes and punctuation.

vectors.name: WordPackage Full Layout Integration
vectors.description: Validates full WordPackage::layout() execution on baseline.docx producing valid LayoutDocument.

vectors.name: Subphase 3.2.1 Test Vectors Manifest Validation
vectors.description: Asserts synchronization between test suite and evidence vector manifest with >= 25 vectors.
